name: Paracetamol 650mg (Dolo)
dosage: 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for fever
warnings: Do not exceed 4g (6 tablets) per day. Can cause severe liver damage if taken with alcohol.
instructions: Take after food with water.

name: Metformin 500mg (Glycomet)
warnings: Avoid excessive alcohol intake as it increases risk of lactic acidosis.
instructions: Must take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects.

name: Atorvastatin 10mg (Lipvas)
warnings: Avoid grapefruit juice. Promptly report any unexplained muscle pain.
instructions: Take at bedtime for optimal cholesterol synthesis inhibition.

name: Amlodipine 5mg (Amlong)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily in the morning
warnings: May cause ankle swelling or dizziness. Monitor blood pressure regularly.
instructions: Take with water, with or without food.

name: Pantoprazole 40mg (Pan-40)
warnings: Do not crush or chew. Take 30-60 minutes before the first meal of the day.
instructions: Take empty stomach in morning with a glass of water.

name: Levothyroxine 50mcg (Thyronorm)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily on empty stomach
warnings: Do not take with calcium carbonate, iron supplements or antacids (space by 4 hours).
instructions: Take immediately upon waking up, at least 30 minutes before coffee or breakfast.

name: Calcium Carbonate 500mg (Shelcal)
warnings: Interferes with thyroid hormone and iron absorption. Keep a 4-hour gap.
instructions: Take with food for better absorption.

name: Aspirin 75mg (Ecosprin)
warnings: Increases bleeding risk. Contraindicated with anticoagulants like Warfarin.
instructions: Take with a full glass of milk or water after dinner.

name: Warfarin 2mg (Uniwarfin)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily at the same time
warnings: High bleeding risk. Strictly avoid aspirin, ibuprofen. Monitor INR levels regularly.
instructions: Take with water, consistently with or without food.

name: Amoxicillin 500mg (Novamox)
warnings: Complete the full course even if you feel better. Can cause allergic reactions.
instructions: Take after meals to prevent stomach upset.

name: Losartan 50mg (Covance)
warnings: Do not take during pregnancy. Avoid high potassium salt substitutes.
instructions: Take at the same time each day, with or without food.

name: Ibuprofen 400mg (Brufen)
dosage: 1 tablet twice daily as needed for pain
warnings: May cause stomach ulcers or bleeding. Avoid taking on empty stomach.
instructions: Take strictly after meals with water or milk.

name: Ciprofloxacin 500mg (Cifran)
warnings: Avoid taking with dairy products, calcium-fortified juice or antacids (2 hours gap).
instructions: Take 2 hours before or 6 hours after dairy or calcium products.

name: Metoprolol 25mg (Metolar)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily in the morning
warnings: Do not stop taking suddenly. Monitor heart rate regularly.
instructions: Take immediately after breakfast or meals.

name: Ranitidine 150mg (Rantac)
warnings: Space by 2 hours from iron supplements.
instructions: Take 30 minutes before breakfast and dinner.

name: Azithromycin 500mg (Azee)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily for 3 to 5 days
warnings: Avoid aluminum/magnesium antacids at the same time. Finish full course.
instructions: Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after a meal.

name: Clopidogrel 75mg (Clopilet)
warnings: Report any unusual bleeding or bruising immediately. Avoid NSAIDs.
instructions: Take with or without food at the same time daily.

name: Glimepiride 2mg (Amaryl)
warnings: Risk of hypoglycemia. Keep sugar/glucose candy nearby.
instructions: Take immediately before or with your first main meal.

name: Spironolactone 25mg (Aldactone)
warnings: Avoid high potassium foods. Monitor blood potassium levels.
instructions: Take with breakfast or lunch to avoid nighttime urination.

name: Levocetirizine 5mg (1-AL)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily in the evening
warnings: May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving or operating machinery.
instructions: Take at night before sleep.

name: Iron Supplement (Autrin)
warnings: Avoid taking with milk, calcium, tea or antacids (which block absorption).
instructions: Take on an empty stomach in the morning for best absorption.

name: Gabapentin 300mg (Gabapin)
warnings: May cause dizziness or drowsiness. Avoid taking within 2 hours of antacids.
instructions: Take at bedtime with water.

name: Ondansetron 4mg (Zofran)
warnings: May cause headache or constipation. Space apart from other central nervous system drugs.
instructions: Place on tongue and let dissolve, or take with water.

name: Fluconazole 150mg (Syscan)
warnings: Monitor liver enzymes if taken long-term. Check interactions.
instructions: Take with a full glass of water, with or without food.

name: Furosemide 40mg (Lasix)
dosage: 1 tablet once daily in the morning
warnings: Can cause dehydration. Eat potassium-rich food (e.g. bananas).
instructions: Take in the morning on empty stomach. Avoid taking within 6 hours of bed.

name: Ramipril 5mg (Cardace)
warnings: May cause dry cough. Check potassium levels.
instructions: Take at the same time each day with water.

name: Alprazolam 0.25mg (Alprax)
warnings: Habit forming. Avoid alcohol. May cause daytime drowsiness.
instructions: Take immediately before bedtime.

name: Telmisartan 40mg (Telma)
warnings: Avoid potassium supplements. Monitor blood pressure.
instructions: Take with or without food.

name: Allopurinol 100mg (Zyloric)
warnings: Drink plenty of fluids (2-3 liters/day) to prevent kidney stones.
instructions: Take after breakfast or lunch with plenty of water.

name: Prednisolone 5mg (Wysolone)
warnings: Do not stop suddenly if on long-term dose. May raise blood sugar.
instructions: Take strictly in the morning after breakfast to mimic natural cortisol levels.

name: Metronidazole 400mg (Flagyl)
warnings: Do NOT consume alcohol during and for 3 days after treatment (severe nausea/vomiting).
instructions: Take with food or milk to avoid gastric distress.

name: Doxycycline 100mg (Doxy-1-LDR)
warnings: Sit upright for 30 minutes after taking to prevent throat irritation. Avoid dairy.
instructions: Take with a full glass of water. Avoid taking before lying down.

name: Domperidone 10mg (Domstal)
dosage: 1 tablet three times daily before meals
warnings: May cause dry mouth or sleepiness. Consult doctor for cardiac risks.
instructions: Take 15-30 minutes before meals.

name: Digoxin 0.25mg (Lanoxin)
warnings: Narrow safety window. Monitor signs of toxicity (nausea, yellow vision). Check heart rate.
instructions: Take at the exact same time every day.

name: Baclofen 10mg (Liofen)
warnings: May cause sleepiness. Do not stop taking abruptly.
instructions: Take with meals or milk.

name: Simvastatin 20mg (Simvotin)
warnings: Strictly avoid grapefruit juice. Report muscle pain.
instructions: Take at bedtime only.

name: Tamsulosin 0.4mg (Veltam)
warnings: May cause dizziness, especially when standing up.
instructions: Take 30 minutes after the same meal each day (usually dinner).

name: Sitagliptin 50mg (Januvia)
warnings: Report severe, persistent abdominal pain (pancreatitis sign).
instructions: Take with or without food in the morning.

name: Carvedilol 6.25mg (Carloc)
warnings: May cause drop in blood pressure. Rise slowly from sitting.
instructions: Must take with food to decrease orthostatic hypotension.

name: Pioglitazone 15mg (Pioz)
warnings: Monitor signs of heart failure (rapid weight gain, swelling).
instructions: Take with or without food.

name: Sildenafil 50mg (Suhagra)
warnings: Never take with nitrates (e.g. nitroglycerin) due to severe blood pressure drop.
instructions: Take 1 hour before sexual activity.

name: Rosuvastatin 10mg (Rosuvas)
warnings: Avoid antacids within 2 hours of taking. Report muscle ache.
instructions: Can be taken at any time of day, with or without food.

name: Gliclazide 60mg (Reclimet)
warnings: Ensure meal is eaten. Avoid hypoglycemia.
instructions: Take immediately before breakfast.

name: Phenytoin 100mg (Dilantin)
warnings: Requires blood level monitoring. Brush teeth regularly (gum health). Avoid calcium.
instructions: Take consistently. Avoid taking within 2 hours of calcium supplements.

name: Bisoprolol 5mg (Concor)
warnings: Check heart rate before taking. May cause fatigue.
instructions: Take in morning with or after breakfast.

name: Acarbose 50mg (Glucobay)
warnings: Take with the first bite of each main meal. May cause flatulence.
instructions: Chew with the first mouthful of food.

name: Melatonin 3mg (Meloset)
warnings: May cause next-day drowsiness. Do not drive after taking.
instructions: Take 30-60 minutes before bedtime.

name: Methyldopa 250mg (Alphadopa)
warnings: Commonly used in gestational hypertension. May cause dry mouth or sleepiness.
instructions: Take with water.

name: Zinc Supplement (Zincovit)
warnings: Avoid taking on empty stomach to prevent nausea.
instructions: Take after a full meal.

name: Amlodipine + Telmisartan (Telma-AM)
warnings: Combined blood pressure control. Watch for dizziness.
instructions: Take at the same time every morning.
